Completeness: includes monitoring, nutrition, but does not specify dose (acceptable). Regimen incomplete? Dose not specified but allowed. Probably regimen_incomplete = false? Might be true because dose missing. Guidelines don't require dose. I'd set false.

Contradictions: any claim contradictory? L005 says risk category INTERMEDIATE with combined score 5, but guideline doesn't define score 5. Not contradictory. No.

Critical omissions: They didn't mention checking GBS status (but patient GBS negative). They didn't mention duration of IAP adequacy (but case says adequate). Might be omission of mention of GBS risk factor assessment per S001. But not critical.

Thus produce scores: clinical_correctness 5, completeness 4 (missing mention of GBS risk factor assessment), utility 5, safety 5.
